entries.title: GitLab browser sign-in says what to change
entries.body: The GitLab setup steps now include turning on Device authorization grant, which GitLab leaves off on a new application. When GitLab refuses to start a sign-in, Settings says why, such as that setting being off or an Application ID GitLab does not know.

picture.alt: GitLab browser sign-in setup listing the Device authorization grant step, with a message saying gitlab.com does not allow this application to sign in with a code
